:::{#def-mle}
#### Maximum likelihood estimate

The **maximum likelihood estimate** (MLE) of a parameter vector $\Param$,
written $\hthml$,
is the value of $\Param$ that maximizes the likelihood [@wikipedia_maximum_likelihood_estimation]:

$$\hthml \eqdef \argmax_\Th \Lik(\Th)$$ {#eq-mle}

Source: @wikipedia_maximum_likelihood_estimation.
:::
